title: Alice to optional Connector control plane

requirements.initial: Connector supplies queued file or approval actions.
requirements.expected: Only schema-valid directed actions survive; arbitrary paths/extra fields do not become authority.

evidence.assertion: claims only schema-valid artifact requests and ignores a raw path field
claims only schema-valid UTA requests and ignores extra fields
evidence.scope: Client decode boundary; Connector does not own UTA writes.

requirements.gap: Both real services must agree on claim/error/version behavior during disconnect and restart.

requirements.initial: An Inbox artifact is requested for one Connector.
requirements.expected: It goes only to the named Connector and is not reinterpreted as an Inbox notification.

evidence.assertion: posts a directed artifact delivery without an Inbox notification body
evidence.scope: Request shape verified by a fetch stub.

requirements.gap: Cross-process delivery, retry/idempotency, and optional Connector outage still need a composed journey.
